claims.statement: Allocation rule v18 (east-node-first reservation for multi-node orders, live 22:00 on 2026-09-20) correlates temporally and mechanically with the 06:00 pickup failure
claims.corroboration: All 186 held orders are east-node routed and flagged as split-reservation exceptions by the overnight allocator. Alert shows only east-node lanes affected. Timeline: rule live 22:00, orders stuck 06:00+.
claims.limitation: The rule passed change review and regression suite. No current state diagnostic yet on how split-reservation exceptions interact with carrier pickup.

claims.statement: 186 overnight-allocated orders remain stuck in 'allocated, awaiting pickup' since 06:00
claims.corroboration: Incident channel reports 186 orders. Monitor alert shows 9% of overnight allocations (consistent scale). All routed to east node.
claims.limitation: Exact current count and impact duration need confirmation from live diagnostics.

next_action.rationale: Directly test whether split-reservation exceptions (flagged on every held order) are blocking carrier pickup. This discriminates between rule-logic failure and carrier-side integration issues.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Will reveal if exception records explain the pickup lag and whether carrier-side confirmation is missing for these orders.
